q: Choose the right indirect speech: I said to him, "Why are you working so hard?"
o: I asked him why had he been working so hard.
I asked him why he had been working so hard.
I asked him why was he working so hard.
I asked him why he was working so hard.

q: Nasima said, "What a fine picture it is!" বাক্যের indirect speech হচ্ছে -
o: Nasima said that it is a very fine picture. [প্রাথমিক প্রধান শিক্ষক (বেলী)-০৯]
Nasima exclaimed that it was a very fine picture. প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (পদ্মা)-১২
Nasima exclaimed that it is a very fine picture.
Nasima exclaimed that what a fine picture it was.

q: Choose the correct sentence from the options below:
o: I asked Rashid had he failed.
I asked Rashid that had he failed.
I asked Rashid if he had failed.
I asked Rashid if you had failed.

q: He said, ‘My friends, listen to me.’ (Direct -Indirect)
o: He told them to listen to his friends.
Addressing him, he told them to listen to him.
Addressing his friends, he told them to listen to him.
Addressing him, his friends told them to listen to him.

q: Choose the correct direct speech of: 'He asked me if I could lend him some money.'
o: He said to me, "If I can lend him some money."
He said to me, "Can you lend me some money?"
He said to me, "Could I lend you some money?"
He said to me, "You can lend me some money."
e:
asked ... if বাক্যটি Yes/No Question-এর Indirect রূপ। Direct করতে প্রশ্নবোধক গঠন ফিরিয়ে আনা হয়, if উঠে যায় এবং Auxiliary আগে বসে। could হয় can, me (শ্রোতা) হয় you, আর him হয় me, ফলে Can you lend me some money?
মনে রাখুন:
Indirect-এ প্রশ্নচিহ্ন থাকে না; Direct-এ প্রশ্নচিহ্ন বসে।

q: The player said, "Alas! We have lost the final match." [indirect]
o: The player exclaimed sorrowfully that we have lost the final match
The player exclaimed with sorrow that they had lost the final match.
The player exclaimed with sorrow that they have lost the final match
The player said with grief that they lost the final match.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Rina said, "I saw him here yesterday."
o: Rina said that she saw him here yesterday.
Rina said that she had seen him here the previous day.
Rina said that she had seen him there the previous day.
Rina said that I had seen him there yesterday.
e:
Reported Speech-এ Past Simple হয় Past Perfect। আবার here হয় there, আর yesterday হয় the previous day। I, বক্তা Rina হওয়ায়, হয় she। সবকটি পরিবর্তন একসঙ্গে ঘটলে তবেই বাক্য শুদ্ধ হয়।
মনে রাখুন:
last night → the previous night; next week → the following week; ago → before।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Hurrah! We have won the game."
o: He exclaimed with joy that they won the game.
He exclaimed with sorrow that they had won the game.
He cried out of joy that they had won the game.
He exclaimed with joy that they had won the game.

q: Rina said, "I had read the topic thoroughly before the exam". (Make it indirect)
o: Rina told me that she had been read the topic thoroughly before the exam.
Rina said that she had read the topic thoroughly before the exam.
Rina told to me that she had read the topic thoroughly before the exam.
Rina said to me that she had been read the topic thoroughly before the exam.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, "Where did you buy this book?"
o: He asked me where I had bought that book.
He asked me where did I buy this book.
He asked me where I bought this book.
He asked me that where I had bought that book.
e:
Wh-question-এর Indirect রূপে ক্রিয়ার ক্রম স্বাভাবিক বাক্যের মতো হয় (Subject + Verb), প্রশ্নবোধক ক্রম থাকে না। did buy হয় had bought, you হয় I, আর this হয় that। কোনো that যুক্ত হয় না, Wh-word-ই সংযোজক।
মনে রাখুন:
asked + wh-word + S + V (প্রশ্নচিহ্ন ছাড়া)।

q: The old woman said to the girl, "May you prosper in life." [indirect]
o: The old woman wished that the girl might prosper in life.
The old woman prayed to the girl that she might prosper in life.
The old woman told that the girl could prosper in life.
The old woman wished the girl that she may prosper in life.

q: Lopa said, "I must leave now." (Change the speech)
o: Lopa said that she had to leave then.
Lopa said that she has to leave now.
Lopa said that she must leave now.
Lopa said that she had to leave now.

q: V. In each of the following questions, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested select the one which best express the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech (Qs.44-45). ৪৪) My friend said to me, "Has your father returned from Chattogram?"
o: My friend enquired me if his father has returned from Chattogram
My friend asked me if my father had returned from Chattogram
My friend said to me that my father has returned from Chattogram
My friend told me that his father had returned from Chattogram
e: Interrogative বাক্যকে Indirect করতে said to বদলে asked হয়, আর yes/no ধরনের প্রশ্নে সংযোজক হিসেবে if বা whether বসে। উক্তির ভেতরের your শ্রোতাকে (me) বোঝাচ্ছে, তাই তা my হবে। Reporting verb অতীত কালে থাকায় present perfect 'has returned' বদলে past perfect 'had returned' হয়, আর প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন উঠে গিয়ে বাক্যটি সাধারণ বিবৃতির রূপ নেয়। প্রথম অপশনে 'enquired me' ভুল (হওয়া উচিত enquired of me), সঙ্গে his father আর has returned দুটোই ভুল। তৃতীয় ও চতুর্থ অপশনে প্রশ্নকে বিবৃতিতে বদলে ফেলা হয়েছে, যা অর্থই পাল্টে দেয়। Wh-প্রশ্নে if বসে না, wh-শব্দটিই সংযোজক হয়, যেমন He said to me, "Where do you live?" থেকে He asked me where I lived.

q: He said to me, "Can you give me some water now?"
o: He asked me whether if I could give him some water then.
He asked me whether I could give him some water then.
He asked me if I could give him some water now.
He asked me if I could give him some water.

q: She said to me, "Let us start the meeting." [Indirect]
o: She proposed to me that we should start the meeting.
She proposed to me that we start the meeting.
She proposed to that we should start the meeting.
She propose me that we should start the meeting.

q: She said, "What a marvelous performance it was!" [indirect]
o: She exclaimed with sorrow that it had been a very marvelous performance.
She exclaimed on joy what a marvelous performance it was.
She exclaimed that it was a very marvelous performance.
She said that it was a marvelous performance.

q: The waiter said, "Thank you, Sir". (Make it indirect)
o: The waiter thanked his customer.
The waiter addressed the person 'sir' and said thank you.
The waiter respectfully thanked the person spoken to.
The waiter told that thank you sir.

q: Choose the correct sentence____
o: I asked Tashfia if she had passed.
I asked Tashfia if you had she passed.
I asked Tashfia that had she passed.
I asked Tashfia had she passed.
e: ‘I asked Tashfia if she had passed.’ বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ, কারণ Yes/No প্রশ্নকে indirect speech-এ নিলে if বা whether বসে এবং বাক্যটি প্রশ্নের ক্রম ছেড়ে সাধারণ বিবৃতির ক্রম (subject + verb) নেয়। Direct রূপটি হবে: I said to Tashfia, "Have you passed?" এখানে reporting verb past tense হওয়ায় present perfect (have passed) বদলে past perfect (had passed) হয়েছে, আর you হয়েছে she। ‘if you had she passed’ অর্থহীন শব্দক্রম, ‘that had she passed’-এ প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্যে that বসানো ভুল, আর ‘had she passed’-এ if/whether নেই এবং প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে। Wh-প্রশ্নের ক্ষেত্রে if বসে না, wh-শব্দটিই থাকে, যেমন: He asked me where I lived.

q: He said, “Had I been a rich man!” (Make it Indirect)
o: He wished he had been a rich man.
He wished if he had been a rich man.
He wished he were a rich man.
He said that he had been a rich man.

q: Change the narration: He asked, "Have you seen my keys?"
o: He asked if I had seen his keys.
He asked where my keys were.
He asked me to see his keys.
He asked when I had seen his keys.
